title: norite token --json
description:
The machine-readable output of `norite token create`, `list` and `revoke` (M22): API tokens, the credential a script or bot holds.

Versioned source of truth (CLAUDE.md rule 15): a change to what these commands print ships with a change to this file in the same commit. The shapes are the CLI's, re-declared from the instance's rather than passed through. Every nullable field is present and null, every list is [] rather than null, and every string an instance sent is exactly as sent, with what a terminal would act on escaped as \uXXXX.

`create` is the only output in this directory that carries a secret. It is the one moment the value exists outside the instance's hash of it.

token.description: One live token, without its value, which nothing can show after creation.

id.description: A Snowflake ID, as a decimal string.

name.description: The label chosen at creation, exactly as the instance returned it.

scopes.description: The scopes the token is limited to. Never null. A string rather than an enum: a newer instance may know a scope this file does not.

last_used_at.description: Null until first use. The instance records it at most once every few minutes.

tokenList.description: Every token of the account that has not been revoked.

minted.description: A token just created, with its value or the file the value went to.

id.description: A Snowflake ID, as a decimal string.

name.description: The label chosen at creation, exactly as the instance returned it.

scopes.description: The scopes the token is limited to. Never null. A string rather than an enum: a newer instance may know a scope this file does not.

last_used_at.description: Null until first use. The instance records it at most once every few minutes.

value.description: The credential itself, shown this once. Null when --out wrote it to a file instead.

written_to.description: The file --out wrote the value to, or null when the value is in `value`. Exactly one of the two is null.
